name: dark-factory
description: The dark factory for Claude Code: fences, a quota guard and a merge transaction for agent-driven development.

plugins.name: dark-factory
plugins.description: Start with guardrails, grow into a dark factory: Claude Code agents on GitHub, for a solo developer or a small studio. Day one (/dark-factory:init): hooks that hold the rules instead of CLAUDE.md requests — no force push, no push to main, no hook bypass, merges only on green CI, a quota guard that saves work before the limit. Then one level at a time (/dark-factory:add): specs and a task queue, review roles, releases only of accepted work, a server where sessions survive reboots and run unattended, an On-call agent in the client's chat and a production monitor. Silent until a project opts in. Requires python3 3.11+ and git; gh and jq for merges.
